islands.tokenSource: Original PDF token-highlight cells and text words; punctuation and original subword fragments are kept in source order.

integration.mode: Inline each staged.svg once; unique id prefixes prevent collisions. Staged SVG shows the original complete figure if scripts fail.
integration.sequence: Show all data-stage <= currentStage. Islands has 132 individual data-token-index steps in natural reading order; keep stage 1 visible throughout. Its source highlights appear with each token. There is no transient focus overlay.
integration.accessibility: Under reduced motion show all stages. Disable aria-live for per-token progress; keep Play/Pause and Replay controls available.
integration.timing: Use durationMs as step holds. Islands token reveal can be instant or a 10 ms opacity transition. Its final full mask reveals the unmodified original art and holds it for 3600 ms.
integration.standalone: The animated SVG variants contain scoped CSS loops and reduced-motion fallback, suitable for img embedding.
integration.validation: All original paths and embedded images remain unchanged. Token clip cells have non-overlapping interiors, include their full source highlight rectangles, and contain no neighboring token glyphs. The original art renders once beneath a shared alpha mask; every stage adds only white mask rectangles. The final full mask ensures a seamless completed figure.
